text:
support_jane: Hey team — Customer ACME reporting sharp p99 latency spikes after we flipped int8 quantization profile on their dedicated pool.

support_jane: Symptoms: baseline p50/p95 ok, p99 jumps from ~420ms to >2.1s during tail events, customers see timeouts. Happening since 2139991000 (after the quant-profile rollout). https://redwood-internal/alerts/213999

oncall-bot: ALERT: model=giraffe-13b profile=int8 p99>2s for customer=acme (see timeline)

support_jane: Repro steps I ran:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"giraffe-13b","input":"<~512 tokens>","max_tokens":256}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
Sometimes returns in 350ms, sometimes 2s+. Trace header shows fallback path to fp16 for some requests.

ml_ryan: Thanks Jane — likely related to calibration overhead or runtime fallback when kernel selection fails. Two quick theories:
- calibration step triggers per-batch memcpy + re-quant path on first few requests post-rollout
- some attention kernels not available for int8 on older driver -> runtime falls back to fp16 on the same worker which increases tail latency

ml_ryan: Can you paste a sample trace id and the model variant id? Need example of the request that hit fallback.

support_jane: Trace 2139991188, variant:v1-int8-calib-2026-03-10

eng_sam: I dug into the node that served the 2s request. Kernel mismatch + fallback log:
```
[2026-03-13T10:12:34Z] model=giraffe-13b variant=v1-int8-calib-2026-03-10 status=FALLBACK_TO_FP16 reason="kernel_missing:flash-attn-v2"
```
That node then triggered JIT and kernel load causing ~1.6s extra. Also saw >30% of int8 requests go through a slow path when seq_len>384.

ingrid_pm: Customer is on Dedicated with burst autoscale enabled. They expect stable p99 SLA. We need short-term mitigation + root cause.

ml_ryan: Mitigations:
- Immediate: Add routing rule to direct ACME->giraffe-13b:fp16-2026-03-01 for that customer until we fix the int8 kernels.
- Quick patch: prevent int8 profile for seq_len>384 (config toggle)
- Midterm: ship pre-warm kernel loader during deploy and conservative fallback threshold (avoid dynamic fallback on hot path)

eng_sam: I can push the routing rule now. Will also add a health-check that marks node unhealthy if frequent FALLBACK_TO_FP16 events.

support_jane: Please go ahead with routing rule. Customer notified that we're investigating — they want ETA.

eng_sam: Routing rule applied -> ACME is now pinned to fp16 variant for giraffe-13b. p99 dropped back to ~430ms within 3 minutes (monitoring link: https://redwood-internal/metrics/213999).

ml_ryan: For RCA next steps I'll:
- audit quantization calibration config (per-layer thresholds)
- add a canary that forces warmup kernels (5k tokens per node) during rollout
- ensure runtime supports graceful kernel fallback without long JIT

ingrid_pm: Schedule a postmortem with eng+ml+support. For the customer reply: "We've rolled back the int8 variant for your traffic and are rolling a fix to avoid the fallback. We'll follow up with a timeline for re-enabling int8 at lower risk." — ok?

support_jane: OK, I'll send that update. Anything else needed from my side?

ml_ryan: Please collect two dozen example payloads (seq len distribution) from ACME's recent traffic and put them in the incident folder. That'll help calibrate thresholds.

support_jane: Will do and attach to the ticket.

ingrid_pm: Assigning action items and due dates in the PM doc. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
